stories.title: Primaire à gauche : une thérapie collective pour les cinq candidats en guise de dernier débat

en.title: Left primary: collective therapy for five candidates in final debate
en.summary: Five candidates competing for the socialist and social-democratic nomination held their last debate on BFM-TV before the first round, with significant disagreement emerging regarding their stance toward Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

stories.title: Élection présidentielle au Brésil : Flavio Bolsonaro largement devant Lula au 1er tour

en.title: Brazilian presidential election: Flavio Bolsonaro far ahead of Lula in first round
en.summary: In a partial count at midnight, the son of former far-right president Jair Bolsonaro held approximately 50.2% of votes compared to about 41.6% for Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, with 47% of ballots counted.

stories.title: Invectives, retraites, soutien aux lycéens... Ce qu'il faut retenir du dernier débat de la primaire socialiste

en.title: Insults, pensions, support for high school students... What to remember from the final socialist primary debate
en.summary: Five socialist primary candidates debated for nearly three hours in the third and final televised debate before the first round, which will determine the social-democratic representative for the 2027 presidential election.

stories.title: Rapport à LFI, école publique, «révolution fiscale»… Ce qu’il faut retenir du dernier débat télévisé de la primaire socialiste

en.title: Relationship with LFI, public education, "fiscal revolution"... What to remember from the final televised debate of the socialist primary
en.summary: Five candidates participated in their final televised debate on BFMTV less than a week before the first round of voting, with results expected the following Saturday shortly after 8 p.m.

stories.title: Ukraine : la Russie attaque de nouveau un pont à Kiev le jour de la visite du chancelier allemand

en.title: Ukraine: Russia attacks bridge in Kyiv again on day of German chancellor's visit
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv on Sunday to express support and announce additional financial aid to Ukraine. The visit occurred as Russian forces continued attacking a bridge in the capital for the fourth consecutive day.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : la feuille de route de Sébastien Lecornu à ses ministres pour éteindre la colère

en.title: High school blockade: Sébastien Lecornu's roadmap for ministers to defuse anger
en.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu is directing ministers to propose solutions addressing teacher replacements, climate transition, and student representation by late October in response to high school protests.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : Sébastien Lecornu demande que les cours reprennent dès lundi « partout » où la sécurité le permet

en.title: High school blockade: Sébastien Lecornu calls for classes to resume Monday "everywhere" safety permits
en.summary: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu instructed ministers to resume classes on Monday where security allows and to develop five initiatives addressing issues raised by academic councils representing student voices, with initial decisions expected by month's end.

stories.title: Blocage des lycées : la réponse de Sébastien Lecornu au mouvement lycéen «en cinq chantiers»

en.title: High school blockade: Sébastien Lecornu's response to student movement "in five areas"
en.summary: Following a week of high school protests, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced a series of objectives addressing student demands and called for classes to resume everywhere starting Monday.

stories.title: La feuille de route de Lecornu, 160 lycées fermés en Ile de France, des mineurs poursuivis… Le point sur la mobilisation lycéenne

en.title: Lecornu's roadmap, 160 high schools closed in Ile de France, minors prosecuted… Update on student mobilization
en.summary: French high school students have mobilized, resulting in school closures across Ile de France and legal proceedings against some minors. The government is responding with policy measures to address the movement.

stories.title: Sébastien Lecornu adresse une feuille de route de "cinq chantiers" à ses ministres et demande des "décisions" avant la fin du mois pour répondre au mouvement lycéen

en.title: Sébastien Lecornu addresses a roadmap of "five priorities" to his ministers and requests "decisions" before month-end to respond to student movement
en.summary: The government minister sent a letter to colleagues outlining five key priorities to address student mobilization, with decisions required by month-end. He also requested classes resume wherever security conditions permit beginning Monday.

stories.title: Présidentielle au Brésil : le duel Lula-Bolsonaro domine le scrutin

en.title: Brazilian presidential election: the Lula-Bolsonaro duel dominates the poll
en.summary: Approximately 160 million Brazilian voters went to the polls to choose between leftist president Lula and far-right rival Flavio Bolsonaro. The election represents a crucial societal choice in a polarized country with international implications.

stories.title: Un pont de Kiev attaqué par un drone russe pendant la visite surprise du chancelier allemand, Friedrich Merz, dans la capitale ukrainienne

en.title: A Kiev bridge attacked by Russian drone during surprise visit of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz to Ukrainian capital
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made a surprise visit to Kiev, stating Ukraine needs support in the coming weeks. Russia continues to bomb essential infrastructure across the country.

stories.title: Lionel Messi et Cristiano Ronaldo : l'un part en héros, l'autre en star déchue

en.title: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo: one leaves as a hero, the other as a fallen star
en.summary: Lionel Messi was celebrated in Buenos Aires for his final appearance with Argentina after 208 matches. Cristiano Ronaldo departed the Portuguese national team during the same week under contentious circumstances.

stories.title: Le cancer du sein frappe de plus en plus de jeunes femmes en France

en.title: Breast cancer increasingly affecting young women in France
en.summary: Over 3,000 French women under 40 are diagnosed with breast cancer annually, with rising numbers and more aggressive forms of the disease presenting a research challenge.

stories.title: Le judo français, un colosse olympique en manque de domination

en.title: French judo, an Olympic giant lacking dominance
en.summary: With less than two years until the Los Angeles Olympics, no French judoka currently dominates their weight category, though strong results at the World Championships in Azerbaijan could alter this situation.

stories.title: Anne-Cécile Mailfert, présidente de la Fondation des femmes : « On veut arrêter de ramasser les victimes à la petite cuillère »

en.title: Anne-Cécile Mailfert, president of the Foundation for Women: "We want to stop picking up victims with a small spoon"
en.summary: A comprehensive law to combat sexual and gender-based violence is being examined in the National Assembly this week, with a solemn vote scheduled for October 13.

stories.title: Pétrole : sites cachés, réserves… Tout comprendre au stock stratégique français

en.title: Oil: hidden sites, reserves… Understanding France's strategic stockpile
en.summary: As France is called upon to draw from its petroleum reserves, the country's strategic stockpiles remain poorly understood in terms of ownership, storage location, and conditions for government release.
